value.rationale: The theorem classifies an entire three-integer graph family, showing that a sharp triangle inequality deletes precisely one edge orbit and yields the unique unrestricted optimal stochastic matrix and its Kemeny value. This is a natural, structurally useful all-size benchmark distinct from general convexity or a few tested instances.
